us_election.reading: retrenchment — the backlash wins and Washington turns inward, slower and preoccupied

events.title: Major Cyber Incident
events.description: A large, largely automated attack lands. Its form is chosen at the time – a ransomware sweep across public services, a compromised software dependency with an unknown blast radius, or disruption of infrastructure directly – and severity scales with how far offensive capability has outrun defence. Damage is real and public, defenders are visibly behind, and attribution takes months. Whoever ran it, the tooling was model-generated.

events.title: Automated Decision Scandal
events.description: An AI-supported decision system in social insurance, policing or the courts is found to have systematically wronged people, with a judgment or an ombudsman finding behind it. Restriction becomes cheap and adoption becomes politically impossible for years. Metric rule 6's internal-origin clause applies in full.

portfolio.name: Mandatory Incident Reporting and Threat Sharing Network
portfolio.description: Establish a legally binding, real-time incident reporting regime for all frontier AI developers and critical infrastructure operators, with immediate data sharing among EU agencies and qualified partners — **in flight**
